decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree sits in the core dairy range and costs little to carry, so despite no website visibility since 2018 the option is still worth holding.
As a flagship cheese it carries strategic value, and with no negative signal it is worth keeping open, though the lack of recent mentions tempers confidence.

After several years with no further evidence of traction beyond a bare mention, the uncertainty has resolved toward low value, and the resources are better spent on the core business or new development.
The multi-variant spicy cheese line can be pruned variant by variant rather than abandoned, so keeping the line keeps flexibility at modest cost.
